Context: 10. Resignation

## 10. Resignation  
[ Swamy's Administration and Swamy's -  
Complete Manual on Establishment and Pension Compilation]  
- It should be submitted to the Appointing Authority in respect of the service or post
1. Resignation should be clear and unconditional. in question who is competent to accept it.
2. Resignation from service will generally be accepted straightaway.
